title: APO Roasted Broccoli
description: Fresh broccoli florets roasted at 425°F in the Anova Precision Oven until browned with crispy edges, with optional garlic powder and parmesan.

steps.title: Spread
steps.text: Spread the broccoli on a sheet pan in a single layer without crowding.

steps.title: Roast
steps.text: Roast in the Anova Precision Oven at 425°F, rear fan on high, 0% steam, for 12 to 20 minutes. Start checking at 12 minutes. It is done when lightly browned with crispy edges.

notes: Combined from three of your dinner plans (Chicken Parmesan, Chicken Piccata and Marry Me Chicken). Use the lower end of the time for smaller florets or a lighter batch. The Chicken Piccata plan used 2 heads of broccoli with plain oil, salt and pepper for about 10 minutes. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/4 of recipe): 108 kcal, 5.2 g protein, 12.6 g total carbohydrate, 4.0 g fat, 4.8 g fiber, 311 mg sodium. Based on the measured ingredients; brands and optional additions can change these values.

steps.text: In the preheated 425°F Samsung oven, roast 12–18 minutes until the edges color but the stems stay crisp-tender.
